state.paragraph: On June 28, 2013, the members of the Transaction Committee participated in a telephone conference call with representatives of BofA Merrill Lynch and Goodwin Procter. BofA Merrill Lynch summarized the contacts they had had with certain of the potential bidders. In particular, BofA Merrill Lynch reported that they had spoken with representatives of Party A, as instructed by the Special Committee, who had expressed the view that there would be considerable synergies if Party A were to acquire Mac-Gray and that Party A would be speaking with certain financing sources with respect to funding such a transaction. BofA Merrill Lynch also reported that they had spoken with representatives of Pamplona, as instructed by the Special Committee, who expressed interest in a transaction, including an acquisition of Mac-Gray by its portfolio company, CSC. Pamplona emphasized that business and legal due diligence would be minimal given its familiarity with Mac-Gray and the industry generally.

ledger_rows.Note: Special Committee of six independent directors formed; MacDonald and Rothenberg excluded from sale deliberations over potential rollover conflicts; sale seen as best path versus remaining standalone.
Filing reports 20 NDA signers (2 strategic, 18 financial); Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B and Party C recorded individually; residual 16 financial bidders.
Signed confidentiality and standstill agreement and received an informational package; instructed to submit a preliminary indication by 07/23/2013.
Signed confidentiality and standstill agreement and received an informational package; instructed to submit a preliminary indication by 07/23/2013.
Denied Moab's request to partner exclusively with CSC/Pamplona for a rollover at this stage, permitting later-stage discussions so Moab's equity could be available to other bidders.
Round 1 due date reached; CSC/Pamplona submitted an indication; Party B and Party C submitted late and were reviewed on 07/25/2013.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
